text:
Maya Lin: Nimori AI reached out about listing nimori-11b-lite. They want a marketplace listing + an EdgeFoundry SI bundle. Key asks: EU-only hosting option, and permission to ship q4_0 derivatives to partners. Can we move fast?

Carlos Ruiz: From a marketplace POV we need SPDX/license text, model-card, container sha256, and a short perf snippet. If they allow derivative distribution, we should add a "Derived Artifacts" clause.

Ellen Park: SI note: EdgeFoundry needs either pre-quantized artifacts (q4_0 preferred) or clear rights to generate and redistribute quantized variants. For on-prem bundles, they also want signed OCI images.

Isaac Ford: Ops: EU-only hosting -> geofencing + data residency SLA. Private deployments require KMS integration (customer keys). That will change provisioning flow.

license-bot: Auto-scan: license appears permissive but references CC-BY data in model-card. Recommend explicit language allowing conversion and redistribution of quantized/derived weights, plus provenance headers in artifacts. Uploading draft addendum template.

Maya Lin: Proposed timeline: partner sends artifacts + license today -> ingest & smoke tests (Eng-Platform, 48h) -> quant/eval (Eng-ML, 1-2 days if provided q artifacts; +2 days if Eng-ML must convert) -> SI validation (EdgeFoundry, 3 days) -> 7-day embargo -> co-announce. Is that realistic?

Carlos Ruiz: Yes if we get artifacts + license now. I'll start the SKU draft (Hosted / Dedicated / Private-EU-only) and pricing tiers.

Ellen Park: I'll coordinate EdgeFoundry's validation window. If Nimori can't grant redistribution rights, we can still do hosted-only + API-based SI integration. We should surface that as a fallback.

Isaac Ford: I'll add KMS/HSM integration notes and OCI signing checklist to the onboarding doc. Ops ETA 48h.

Maya Lin: Action items: Carlos -> SKU + marketplace assets (today). Ellen -> SI validation slot + test harness (tomorrow). Isaac -> ops/KMS checklist (48h). Legal -> circulate Derived Artifacts addendum (license-bot flagged). Reconvene 10am PT tomorrow.

Carlos Ruiz: ack :thumbsup:

license-bot: Precedent found: "Derived Artifacts & Geofence Addendum v1" and "Marketplace Host Addendum". Links posted to shared drive.

Ellen Park: ack, will post EdgeFoundry test harness link once confirmed.

Maya Lin: Thanks team. If anybody hits a blocker (especially license or geofence), flag here immediately.
